meta.notes: DRAFT by Claude (s348) for Ben. SWAP (Ben s348): the PYRAMID moves from Ur to LUXOR (Pyramid Path, Pyramid Entry, First Chamber, Gate Hall, Second Chamber, the Pyramid Dig game + the Wrecking Crane); the ZOO (Zoo Path + Hessa's Menagerie) moves from Luxor to UR. LUXOR = a basalt FORTRESS TOWN under a volcano, laid out in RINGS: the red-cobbled square, ringed by the clockwise BIKE TRACK, four avenues out through a black city WALL with four gates. N: Castle Path over the tar SPIKE DITCH (iron bridge) to King Lox's keep + Barracks. E: PIT ROAD (Boxing Gym, Cinder Court) to the FIGHTING PIT. S: Volcano Road over the LAVA RIVER (lava bridge) to the VOLCANO PLAINS, the Volcano Run track and the cave. W: PYRAMID PATH to the great basalt PYRAMID; RED PLAINS branch off it to the north-west (3 bridges, hidden ship). EVERY BUILDING IS UNIQUE ("outside" note) with a roof sign + eye-level door sign. Water entries with "lava": true are LAVA (the viewer should paint them glowing). NPC keys are draft until surface_luxor.html comes in. LOOK (Ben s348): slightly red sky + RED as the build theme colour. THE VOLCANO = terrain hill luxorVolcano (110 m tall, glowing crater, smoke plume) south of the lava river.

buildings.label: Cinder Brigade

buildings.label: The Ember Times

buildings.label: Tower House

buildings.label: Tower House

buildings.label: The Cinder Court

buildings.label: Fighting Pit

buildings.outside: Terraced FIRE-PEPPER farm on black volcanic soil: glass greenhouse domes, a steam vent pipe, red pepper strings drying on racks.

buildings.label: Barracks

look.notes: SLIGHTLY RED SKY (Ben s348): a warm red-tinted dusk, deep red at the top to a red-orange horizon, a little ash in the air (not black, not too dark). RED IS THE BUILD THEME COLOUR: every building uses red (red stone walls, red roofs, red trim, red doors, red L-crest banners) with black basalt as the second colour and iron + lava orange as accents. Glowing lava seams; water marked lava glows orange; the Red Plains river is rust-red water with red grass + scorched trees.

terrain.notes: LUXOR = the volcano world. The walled town, the avenues and the Pit Road stay flat. The VOLCANO is the big cone south of the lava river (cave at its foot); ash dunes and basalt ridges round the plains; the PYRAMID stands on flat ground in the west. The SPIKE DITCH is a tar-filled cut across the Castle Path (iron bridge).

hills.note: THE VOLCANO (Ben: the big landmark, seen from everywhere): a tall cone south of the lava river, a glowing LAVA CRATER at the top with a smoke plume + ember sparks, lava streams down the south face, the Volcano Cave in its north foot (luxorVolcanoCave). The Volcano Run loop + the ash fields at its feet; the Robot Spider can climb it.
